messages:
Jenna (CSM): Heads-up — ValenceHealth flagged low weekly usage and a renewal in 21 days. They hit their usage ceiling last month and switched to a smaller team instance. Need a quick, high-signal save plan we can run this week.
Raj (CS Ops): Got it. Can you share the usage metrics? % active seats, API calls, regen rate?
Jenna (CSM): Quick snapshot: active seats down 38% MoM, API calls down 44%, avg tokens per request steady. Renewal note: finance asked for a 20% discount if they downgrade.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Is this more onboarding friction or actual product fit? Any logs from their integration errors?
Jenna (CSM): No recent errors. They mentioned latency spikes in one convo with SRE, but mostly the product not being embedded deeply; only 3 power users left.
Maya (Product): Suggest micro-engagements: 1) 30-min tailored enablement for power users 2) Build a 2-step email nudges series with CTA to workshop 3) Short feedback survey to capture the real friction.
Jenna (CSM): Love that. Raj — can we do an expedited canary re-issue to their route to reduce latency risk during the workshop?
Raj (CS Ops): Yep. I can reserve a small Dedicated slot for them for 48h and route their traffic. Will require ops-sched approval but should be quick.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I can prep a session template and a troubleshooting runbook. Also propose a "lightweight integration check" script we can run with them during the call.
Jenna (CSM): OK action items:
- Jenna: schedule workshop with 3 power users (this week)
- Liam: integration check script + workshop slides
- Raj: reserve Dedicated slot & temporary routing policy
- Maya: short 6-question survey + one-click booking link
- Jenna: draft renewal offer (avoid headline discount; prefer time-limited credits or extra seats)
Maya (Product): Quick note on survey — keep it under 2 mins, ask: "biggest blocker", "what would make this indispensable?", "willingness to recommend (1-5)", optional freeform.
Jenna (CSM): I'll draft the email cadence. Rough templates below — short + clear.
OnboardBot: Automated suggestion: include a link to product docs and a short video (<=3 mins) for the power user workshop.
Jenna (CSM): Email 1 (to power users):
```
Subject: Quick 30-min session to make ValenceHealth's flow 2x faster
Hi <name>,
We spotted a few opportunity loops in your team’s flow — can we do a 30-min live session this week to walk through quick wins? No heavy setup. Pick a time: <cal link>
Cheers, Jenna
```
Email 2 (follow-up if no response 3 days):
```
Subject: Quick wins for ValenceHealth — saved templates and credits
Hi <name>,
We can also pre-run a short integration check and deliver 3 pre-built templates for your team. If it helps, we can add temporary credits for the pilot week.
Best, Jenna
```
Liam (Solutions Eng): Workshop agenda (30 min):
1) 5m intro + goals
2) 10m integration check (run script)
3) 10m workflow optimization (templates + macros)
4) 5m next steps + booking follow-up
Raj (CS Ops): Ops checklist to enable dedicated routing:
- Request capacity allocation (48h)
- Create routing policy: valencehealth-prod -> dedicated-pool
- Monitor latency + rollback threshold (95th p90 > 350ms triggers rollback)
- Tag invoice for credits if approved
Jenna (CSM): Renewal offer draft — avoid headline %: offer 2 weeks of free dedicated capacity + 3 months of priority support if they sign within 10 days. If they insist on discount, price team to offer 12% max as last resort.
Maya (Product): Add a quality guard: if post-workshop adoption uplift <15% in 14 days, auto-trigger a follow-up with an extended pilot (no extra cost) and schedule product team deep-dive.
Jenna (CSM): Timeline:
- Day 0 (today): message power users + share survey link
- Day 2: reserve Dedicated slot + draft workshop materials
- Day 4-6: run workshop
- Day 12: measure adoption lift; decide renewal negotiation path
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the integration check script to the shared drive and paste snippet here.
Raj (CS Ops): I'll ping infra for quick approval, ETA 6 hours.
Jenna (CSM): One more: capture feedback verbatim in the survey and drop into the renewal play doc. We should use quotes for exec outreach.
Maya (Product): I'm adding a prompt to the survey to capture the "most valuable feature" so we can prioritize follow-ups.
Jenna (CSM): Thanks team — I'll run the outreach now. If anyone hears from the account before the workshop, ping here. :thumbsup:
Liam (Solutions Eng): :rocket: good plan.
Raj (CS Ops): on it.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: nudge power users 48h after first email if no response.
